annotationScope: Only minimized exact phrases from detail.Description are annotated and scored. detail.Place.Cadastral is contextual source metadata and is verified only by the private source check; it is not evidence in this description-text extraction corpus. All 589 records in the captured sampling frame have a nonempty structured cadastral value, so NO_DESCRIPTION_REFERENCE must not be interpreted as absence of structured source data.

source.name: eAukcija root-7 immutable sanitized snapshots
source.samplingFrame: All 589 immutable IMMOVABLE snapshots in the exact root-7 capture fetched at 2026-08-21T17:20:52Z under eaukcija-listing-detail-v1 and public-auction-fields-v1.
source.limitations: The frozen IDs were deliberately selected for extraction-pattern and negative-text coverage. This is not random or prevalence-weighted sampling, and its metrics must not be generalized to the full source population.

review.limitations: The two passes used distinct review IDs and separate evidence-by-evidence decisions, but both were performed by the same automated OpenAI Codex agent. They are not independent human annotation or inter-annotator agreement evidence.

split.heldOutPolicy: The 15-auction held-out file was frozen before the baseline was evaluated. Parser examples and assertions may use development.json only; held-out labels may be read only by aggregate evaluation commands. Changes require a new corpusVersion and two-pass review.

licensingAndProvenanceNote: The source is the public Serbian Ministry of Justice eAukcija portal. No standalone redistribution or automation licence was located in the reviewed source note dated 2026-08-24, so this corpus does not redistribute snapshots or whole descriptions. It retains only short factual phrases necessary to identify a parcel, cadastral municipality, land-register number, address, or a reviewed negative. Images, thumbnails, bidder state, executor names, debtor/creditor names, JMBG values, contact details, prices, and unrelated prose are excluded. Every auction remains traceable by a SHA-256 of the exact #10 sanitized snapshot and hashes of the reviewed source fields. Stop redistribution and re-review this corpus if the source owner objects or publishes incompatible terms.
